g.text: The elaboration of the positional operators (numpy rules)
shapes a and b (ranks from the signature)
align the shapes from the right, and pad
the shorter shape on the left with ones
a fresh index for each result axis
an operand axis of size 1 reads its only element
a 1-D first operand gets a leading axis of size 1,
a 1-D second operand gets a trailing axis of size 1
the inner sizes of the last two axes match?
the leading axes broadcast as above
an index-form term of the core,
with an explicit sum over the inner axis
a TL term: the sugar in, the core out
